text:
alex: Alpenglow12B onboarding — can we prioritize a perf+quality sweep this week? Need throughput/latency (batch profiles), ctx-length sweep, and a basic int8 quant smoke. Target: ~3k tok/s and p50 <60ms at 1k ctx if possible.

maria: added to intake queue. Priority? any hard constraints on hardware or quant targets?

alex: medium-high priority. Use A100-80GB and H100 for head-to-head. Start fp16 baseline then int8 (static) runs. QAT later. Key metrics: tokens/s, p50/p95, GPU mem, and quality delta on our conversation eval set.

jon: I'll kick off coldstart + batch sweep today. Command I'll run:
```
./bench --model alpenglow12b --devices a100-80 --bs 1,2,4,8,16 --ctx 128,512,1024 --quant none --warmup 300
```
Planning separate runs for h100 after baseline.

sam: Please ensure we include a warmup window in CI. We've historically seen throughput increase 12-20% after ~200s. Suggest --warmup 300 and a sustained 15m steady window for measurements. :+1:

alex: also add runs with prefix/KV cache enabled vs disabled. Include a synthetic tail-heavy ctx distribution: mean 64, p99 2048. Tag each run with `ctx_profile=prod_like`.

maria: For quality: I'll run convo-eval and code-eval slices. Pass criteria: BLEU/ROUGE/EM deltas <2% vs baseline; if >3% fail and mark for manual triage. Also run toxicity classifier.

li: note on size: fp16 ~24GB. Expected int8 model ~11-13GB but perf tradeoffs vary by kernel. For int8 runs add `--quant-mode static` and capture memory + nvprof snapshots. Also bench latency tail across batch sizes; sometimes bs=1 p95 spikes on A100 due to kernel launch.

perf-bot: CI job created: `ci/bench/alpenglow12b/sweep-2441112223`. Results will post to #eng-ml-bench. Artifacts: perf csv, nvprof trace, and eval_report.json.

jon: Starting fp16 bench on A100 now (cold). ETA ~2h. Will post short summary when initial numbers are in.

jon: (update) initial fp16 baseline finished for a100: bs=1 p50 42ms p95 120ms; bs=8 tok/s 2.7k; mem usage ~25GB with extra headroom. Will run bs sweep + ctx 1024 next.

alex: good first pass. If bs=8 is 2.7k, we may hit target with optimized kernels or H100. Next steps: 1) run h100 fp16, 2) try int8 on A100, 3) run convo/code eval and compare.

maria: I'll queue quality runs to start as soon as we have fp16 h100 numbers.

sam: created a short checklist in the repo (link pasted in #eng-ml):
- baseline fp16 a100/h100
- batch sweep (1..16)
- ctx sweep (128,512,1024,2048)
- kv cache on/off
- int8 static runs + mem snapshots
- eval convo/code + toxicity
- create triage ticket if quality regression >3%

alex: thanks team. tagging @oncall-ml for awareness in case CI jobs spike infra. We'll reconvene Fri to decide rollout.
